Offer Description

The position is a fully funded 3-year PhD fellowship. The fellowship is funded for 36 months.

The salary is NOK 532,200 per year. Applicants must hold a master's degree in microbiology.

English requirement: IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90. Open to applicants of all nationalities.

Required documents: CV, motivation letter, academic transcripts and two reference letters.
